name: Newtechwood Corp
summary: Established in Huizhou, China, in 2004, Newtechwood Corporation specializes in the full lifecycle of wood-plastic composite materials, from development and manufacturing to sales. The company provides a comprehensive selection of outdoor products, including decking, railing systems, and site furnishings. Additionally, its extensive portfolio features deck tiles, planter boxes, various composite and castellation claddings, and fencing solutions.
